title: Autofahrer verursacht mehrere Verkehrsunfälle mit hohem Sachschaden

extraction.summaryEn: An audi driver caused a hit-and-run collision in Alt-Hohenschönhausen and then a second crash on Buschallee in Weißensee, where a car burned out and ten parked vehicles were damaged. Two people, the driver and a 64-year-old woman, were injured.
